Meet Websa Worldwide's directors, Lazarus Magura and Collins Ndewere, and the Guangzhou head office and Africa delivery office that handle procurement, shipping, installation and training.

Founding director. Started the WEBSA programme in Zimbabwe in 1999 to make farmers and their value chain self-sufficient, and has led its agricultural, equipment and energy projects since. A director and shareholder of both Websa companies.

Director. Brought the programme to South Africa through Ndewere Corporation in 2008 and NDECOR Trading in 2014, and directed the Northern Cape solar street lighting and the Lesedi and Letsatsi programme work. A director and shareholder of both Websa companies.
